description: This PHP source file defines the CharacterConvert class, which provides static methods for converting characters to their ASCII values and vice versa within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes functions for handling single values and arrays, performing encoding conversions, and validating inputs.

classes.name: CharacterConvert
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for converting characters to ASCII codes and vice versa, accommodating array inputs and encoding compatibility.

methods.name: character
methods.description: Converts an integer value or array of values to their character representations, handling encoding and validation.

methods.name: code
methods.description: Converts a string or array of strings to their ASCII code values, processing single characters and handling encoding.

methods.name: unicodeToOrd
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 string character to its Unicode ordinal value.
